# AI Resume Tailor

> AI Resume Tailor is a web app that tailors your existing resume to a specific job description and includes a free ATS resume checker. Your first 3 tailored resumes are free; further access is a one-time purchase with no subscription.

## Core pages
- [Free ATS Resume Checker](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-checker): ATS compatibility score, formatting, and missing-keyword analysis.
- [Resume Optimizer](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-optimizer): Tailors your resume to a job description.
- [Pricing](https://airesumetailor.com/pricing): One-time access tiers; the first 3 tailored resumes are free.
- [FAQ](https://airesumetailor.com/faq): Common questions about resume tailoring and ATS.
- [Blog](https://airesumetailor.com/blog): Guides on resume tailoring, ATS, and keywords.

- [Resume keywords hub](https://airesumetailor.com/keywords): ATS keyword and action-verb guides by role.
